title: Ninth Word Why The Five Daily Prayers Are Assigned To Their Times

questions.question: What is being asked about in this passage?
questions.answer: Why the five daily prayers are at certain times.

questions.question: How many reasons does the passage explain fully?
questions.answer: One reason.

questions.question: What does each prayer time mark the start of?
questions.answer: A big change.

questions.question: Besides marking a big change, what else does each prayer time show?
questions.answer: Allah’s power and His many gifts.

questions.question: Why are people told to glorify and praise Allah more at those times?
questions.answer: Because many blessings gather between those times.

questions.question: What are students told to do to understand this meaning better?
questions.answer: Listen carefully to the five points.

questions.question: What are the three main parts of the meaning of prayer?
questions.answer: Glorifying, praising, and thanking Allah.

questions.question: Where are these meanings found in prayer?
questions.answer: In all its words and movements.

questions.question: What topic does this passage begin to explain?
questions.answer: The wisdom in the times of the five daily prayers.

questions.question: Does the passage try to give every wisdom, or only a small part?
questions.answer: Only a small part.

questions.question: What happens at each prayer time according to the passage?
questions.answer: An important turning point begins.

questions.question: What do those times reflect about Allah?
questions.answer: His power and His blessings.

questions.question: Why is praise and thanks fitting at those times?
questions.answer: Because many gifts from Allah are remembered then.

questions.question: How many points are mentioned to help explain the meaning?
questions.answer: Five points.

questions.question: What is the basic meaning of the prayers?
questions.answer: To glorify, praise, and thank Allah.

questions.question: Are these meanings found in only one small part of prayer or all through it?
questions.answer: All through it.

questions.question: What question is being answered in this passage?
questions.answer: Why the daily prayers have special times.

questions.question: What is one reason those times matter?
questions.answer: They match important changes and reminders of Allah’s gifts.

questions.question: What should a believer do at those times because of Allah’s many blessings?
questions.answer: Glorify, praise, and thank Allah more.

questions.question: What is the reader invited to listen to next?
questions.answer: Five points.

questions.question: In simple words, what is prayer mostly about?
questions.answer: Honoring Allah and thanking Him.

questions.question: What does glorifying Allah mean in prayer?
questions.answer: Saying and showing that Allah is above every fault.

questions.question: Why are these three ideas very important in prayer?
questions.answer: Because every part of prayer carries them.

questions.question: What does worship teach a servant to notice about himself?
questions.answer: That he has faults and needs Allah.

questions.question: What feelings should fill the servant in worship?
questions.answer: Love, wonder, and humility.

questions.question: If Allah is perfect and pure, how should the servant speak about Him?
questions.answer: As free from every defect and wrong idea.

questions.question: What should the servant realize when he looks at his own weakness and the weakness of creation?
questions.answer: That Allah’s power is great.

questions.question: After realizing that, what two things should the servant do?
questions.answer: Trust Allah and seek refuge in Him.

questions.question: Why does mercy lead the servant to make du‘a?
questions.answer: Because he and all creatures have many needs.

questions.question: How does the servant answer Allah’s gifts?
questions.answer: With thankfulness and praise.

questions.question: How is a person like the big world?
questions.answer: A person is a small example of it.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the prayers and all kinds of worship?
questions.answer: The prayers gather and point to all of them.

questions.question: What part of prayer is the passage helping to explain?
questions.answer: The wisdom of the set prayer times.

questions.question: Why are the prayer times special moments?
questions.answer: They begin important changes and show Allah’s power and blessings.

questions.question: What should people do more at those moments?
questions.answer: Glorify Allah, praise Him, and thank Him.

questions.question: Why is thankfulness especially fitting between one prayer time and the next?
questions.answer: Because countless blessings come in that time.

questions.question: What must someone do to understand this deep meaning a little?
questions.answer: Listen to the five points.

questions.question: Name the three core meanings inside prayer.
questions.answer: Glory, greatness, and thanks to Allah.

questions.question: How should a Muslim show glory to Allah?
questions.answer: By words and by actions of worship.

questions.question: What does saying Allah is the Greatest tell us about Him?
questions.answer: He has perfect greatness.

questions.question: Why does the passage compare these three meanings to seeds?
questions.answer: Because they are the beginning of the whole prayer.

questions.question: In how much of the prayer are these meanings found?
questions.answer: In every part.

questions.question: What is the purpose of repeating the blessed words after prayer?
questions.answer: To strengthen the meaning of prayer.

questions.question: In worship, how should a servant view himself?
questions.answer: As weak, needy, and imperfect.

questions.question: How should he respond in Allah’s presence?
questions.answer: By prostrating with love and amazement.

questions.question: What should a servant do when he sees his sins and faults?
questions.answer: Ask Allah to forgive him.

questions.question: What else should he say about Allah at that time?
questions.answer: That Allah is completely pure and above all faults.

questions.question: What does the servant learn from seeing the weakness of creatures?
questions.answer: That only Allah has complete power.

questions.question: What should a servant do with his worries and fears?
questions.answer: Take refuge in Allah and trust Him.

questions.question: Why is asking Allah for needs part of worship?
questions.answer: Because Allah’s mercy is endless and we are needy.

questions.question: What should the servant announce about Allah’s gifts?
questions.answer: That they are blessings deserving thanks.

questions.question: What are the prayer’s words and actions said to include?
questions.answer: The meanings of worship.

questions.question: At the end, how are the prescribed prayers described?
questions.answer: As a bright guide to all the kinds of worship done by creatures.

questions.question: What is the main lesson in the opening lines of the passage?
questions.answer: The times of the five prayers have wisdom.

questions.question: How does the passage describe each prayer time?
questions.answer: As a sign of a major change.

questions.question: What two things are seen in those times?
questions.answer: Allah’s power and His gifts.

questions.question: What grows between the prayer times that calls for thanks?
questions.answer: Many blessings.

questions.question: What does the passage say prescribed prayer means in a simple way?
questions.answer: Glorifying, praising, and thanking Allah.

questions.question: What does a person do when he glorifies Allah?
questions.answer: He honors Allah as far above every flaw.

questions.question: What does a person do when he says Allah is the Greatest?
questions.answer: He lifts up Allah’s perfect greatness.

questions.question: What does a person do when he praises Allah?
questions.answer: He thanks Allah with all of himself.

questions.question: Why are these acts so central to prayer?
questions.answer: Because they are in all its words and actions.

questions.question: What should worship help a servant recognize about himself?
questions.answer: His faults, weakness, and poverty.

questions.question: When he knows that, how should he stand before Allah?
questions.answer: Humbly, lovingly, and with wonder.

questions.question: What does seeking forgiveness show?
questions.answer: That the servant admits his faults.

questions.question: What does saying Allah is pure and above faults show?
questions.answer: That Allah has no defect at all.

questions.question: Why does the servant say Allah is Most Great after seeing weakness?
questions.answer: Because Allah’s power is amazing and majestic.

questions.question: What two actions of the heart come with that?
questions.answer: Trusting Allah and turning to Him for protection.

questions.question: Why does the servant ask for what he needs?
questions.answer: Because Allah’s mercy is endless and the servant is needy.

questions.question: How should the servant speak about Allah’s blessings?
questions.answer: With thankful praise.

questions.question: Are the forms of prayer random, or do they carry meaning?
questions.answer: They carry meaning.

questions.question: How is a human being described compared with the whole world?
questions.answer: Like a tiny model of it.

questions.question: What is being explained about the five daily prayers?
questions.answer: The wisdom of their special times.

questions.question: Does the passage say there is only one wisdom in those times?
questions.answer: No, it gives one from many wisdoms.

questions.question: What does each prayer time begin?
questions.answer: An important new stage or change.

questions.question: What does each prayer time reflect from Allah?
questions.answer: Divine power and wide-reaching blessings.

questions.question: Why should believers increase praise and thanks at those times?
questions.answer: Because uncountable blessings have been given.

questions.question: What does the passage call the required prayers in relation to this meaning?
questions.answer: A way of glorifying, praising, and thanking Allah.

questions.question: What does glorifying Allah involve?
questions.answer: Speaking and acting in worship before His greatness.

questions.question: What does exalting Allah involve?
questions.answer: Declaring His complete perfection and greatness.

questions.question: What does praising Allah involve?
questions.answer: Thanking Him with heart, speech, and actions.

questions.question: Why are these three called the seeds of prayer?
questions.answer: Because the rest of prayer comes from them.

questions.question: How fully do these meanings spread through prayer?
questions.answer: They are present in every part.

questions.question: What is the reason for repeating the blessed words after prayer?
questions.answer: To make the prayer’s meaning stronger again.

questions.question: What three things does the servant come to see about himself in worship?
questions.answer: Faults, weakness, and need.

questions.question: What does Allah’s lordship call the servant to do?
questions.answer: Worship and obey.

questions.question: What should the servant do after noticing his faults?
questions.answer: Seek forgiveness.

questions.question: What truth about Allah should he announce with words of glory?
questions.answer: Allah is pure and free from every defect.

questions.question: What should the servant understand by looking at weak creatures?
questions.answer: All of them are powerless compared with Allah.

questions.question: What does he do after that understanding?
questions.answer: He says Allah is Most Great, bows low, and trusts Allah.

questions.question: Why does Allah’s mercy lead the servant to supplicate?
questions.answer: Because all creatures have needs and Allah gives gifts.

questions.question: What should the servant do in return for Allah’s gifts?
questions.answer: Offer thanks and praise.

questions.question: What comparison is made between man and the universe?
questions.answer: Man is a small example of the larger world.

questions.question: What comparison is made between the prescribed prayers and worship in creation?
questions.answer: The prayers are a bright index and map of all kinds of worship.
